placeholderImages.description: A completely flat, ultra-minimalist iOS app icon. A single, clean, elegant white geometric shape (like a simple 4-point spark, a minimalist checkmark, or a sleek line-art utility symbol) in the exact center. The background is a solid, deep matte black. No 3D effects, no gradients, no shadows, no text. Extremely clean, simple, and professional vector art style.
